item.title: Why I Find Myself Competing Against the Snowboarder I Used to Be
item.description: The author spent years chasing powder in Lake Tahoe. Snowboarding was everything. But today, he finds himself competing against the snowboarder he used to be.

item.title: SESSIONS: Frankie Seely and the Queen of the Coast
item.description: SESSIONS is our new series made for surfers, by surfers. In the first episode, Malibu local Frankie Seely surfs Rincon on a brand new board by Michael Takayama.

item.title: Man Buried in Avalanche Rescued After Wife Uses Find My Phone App to Locate Him
item.description: A Washington man found himself buried in an avalanche and his wife was able to send his location to rescuers using the Find My Phone app.

item.title: Taj Burrow on Legacy, Family, and Life After the Tour
item.description: Taj Burrow should have won at least one world title. Now that he's retired from full time competition, his life has changed drastically. Here's what he's up to.

item.title: Russia Has Entered the Surf Park Race With Home-Grown Beginner Wave
item.description: A Russian company, Vertigo Sports, has emerged as another player in the global wave pool technology race. The company recently posted new videos of longboarders riding its pool in Rostov-on-Don, Russia. The website claims the pool creates a wave 1.5 meters high that runs for 120 meters. item.title: Despite Historic February Storm Activity, California’s Snowpack Is Well Below Average
item.description: On February 27, the Department of Water Resources announced that the statewide snowpack was 66 percent of its average for its calendar date.

item.title: Watch the Moment Two Oarfish Washed Up Alive on a Cabo Beach
item.description: When two sisters were walking on the beach in Cabo, they ran into a pair of oarfish. Seeing one is rare, but seeing two is just about impossible.

item.title: One of the Gnarliest Nazaré Wipeouts You’ll Ever See Happened Yesterday
item.description: Alberto Truncer took a Nazaré lip on the head during the type of wipeout rarely seen at the Portuguese big wave spot. Reports say he's okay after the incident.

item.title: Gold Coast Carnage: 2 Minutes of Wipeouts from Summer 2026
item.description: If you surf, you wipe out. No one is immune, from the newest of noobs to the Kelliest of Slaters. And on the Gold Coast, there are more surfers to fall.

item.title: This Surf Shop Is Proving the Team Rider Concept Still Works
item.description: WND&WVS, a surf shop on the shores of Vermont's Lake Champlain, is proving that the team rider concept of sports marketing still works. And they're leaning in.
